pages.text: Add a capacitor, FE, an axe and shears. The tools wear as the machine finishes jobs.

pages.title: Z-Logic Controller
pages.text: For one Z-Logic Controller, fill the top row with Soularium, a Zombie Head and Soularium. Fill the bottom row with Silicon, Redstone Dust and Silicon. This is a 20,000 FE job.

pages.title: Ender Resonator
pages.text: For one Ender Resonator, use Soularium, Enderman Head and Soularium on top. Put Silicon, Vibrant Alloy and Silicon below. It costs 20,000 FE and unlocks a wireless antenna.
The other stock parts are the Zombie Electrode, Skeletal Contractor and Guardian Diode. Match the six slots to the recipe pattern. Check the tool slots when the progress stops.
Feed a known recipe into a Pull face with a hopper and take the finished part from an output face. Use a $(l:enderio:machines/sag_mill)SAG Mill$(/l) upstream for Silicon.
